s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic painful intertriginous wounds with granulomatous inflammation
salient_findings: Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques
Granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate with well-formed, nonnecrotizing granulomas
key_facts: 1.5-year history of painful intertriginous wounds
History of hypertension and depression
Multiple hospital admissions for cellulitis around the wounds
Received diverting sigmoid colostomy and indwelling urinary catheter
Wound care required nursing home care
Received adalimumab for 3 months without clinical improvement
Family history of similar condition
Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques present in intertriginous areas
Histopathology showed pseudoepitheliomatous epidermal hyperplasia and granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate
Laboratory tests, including histochemical stains and tissue cultures, were negative
Elevated immunoglobulin G antibodies and flagellins

shortlist.label: Crohn's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated immunoglobulin G antibodies and flagellins, granulomatous inflammation, and family history of similar condition

shortlist.label: Granulomatous slack skin disease
shortlist.why_kept: Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques and granulomatous inflammation

shortlist.label: Hidradenitis suppurativa
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic painful intertriginous wounds and history of cellulitis

shortlist.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
shortlist.why_kept: Painful ulcers and history of inflammatory conditions

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and presence of Langhans-type multinucleated giant cells

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques in intertriginous areas, along with histopathology showing pseudoepitheliomatous epidermal hyperplasia and granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate, is consistent with Granulomatous slack skin disease. The negative laboratory tests and lack of response to adalimumab also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Crohn's disease
rejected.why: The patient's gastrointestinal workup, including computed tomography enterography, upper endoscopy, and colonoscopy, was unremarkable, making Crohn's disease less likely.

rejected.label: Hidradenitis suppurativa
rejected.why: While the patient has intertriginous lesions, the presence of granulomatous inflammation and pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia on histopathology is not typical of hidradenitis suppurativa.

rejected.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
rejected.why: The patient's lesions do not have the characteristic ulcerative appearance of pyoderma gangrenosum, and the histopathology does not show the typical neutrophilic infiltrate.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: While sarcoidosis can present with granulomatous inflammation, the patient's lack of systemic symptoms and the specific location of the lesions in intertriginous areas make Granulomatous slack skin disease a more likely diagnosis.
